authoring.author: claude-opus-5.5 (wallen OZV face lane)
authoring.note: Pass 2 after the strip sheet: tall window proportion on the cornice fronts (photo sashes ~2 m, the default sat high and short), 119 crownRise 1.6 -> 1.35 (crown overshot the cap by ~0.8 m), greyer bricks (wall-colour check), and fix-facts.ts for 117 (3DBAG wedge + BAG stoep bump broke the 115|117 party line). Oudezijds Voorburgwal 115-125 (odd, east side), 6 pands. Strip from the 2021-01-25 canal-boat capture, picked by hand: the default pick (2021-12-27, quay level 5-6 m from the fronts) and 2021-03-08 (quay) shear and ghost the upper storeys and gables. Rows are strip.jpg pixel rows (ground = row 840, 40 px/m), read on 2x zoom crops with a row ruler. Ground storeys read on the 2021-03-08 quay strip (cars hide them on the boat strip). Lean measured on a level perspective view of boat panorama 000252 (25 m, 55 deg oblique): party lines 121|123 and 123|125 stay within 5 px over ~750 px at ~40 px/m, i.e. <= 0.5 deg, inside the noise; no lean modelled. 113 (171881) and 127-129 (171877) were left out: their BAG/3DBAG fronts have a 1.3-1.4 m forward projection (stoep/risaliet) that the frontage finder takes as the front (113: a 2.2 m front of a ~5.9 m facade).
